items.title: Physical Natural Gas Prices Power Up for Weekend
items.summary: Spot natural gas prices for delivery over the weekend and Monday advanced as the pace of new supply held near seasonal lows and demand started to build.

items.title: ADNOC Announces Another SPA in Deal Spree Aimed at Building Global Natural Gas Business
items.summary: Abu Dhabi National Oil Co. (ADNOC) said Friday its investment arm, XRG, would sell India’s Gujarat Energy 4 Mt/y of LNG beginning in 2028.

items.title: Natural Gas Storage Nears 3.9 Tcf, but Is That Enough for Winter?

items.title: Storage Limits Force Northeast Natural Gas Pipelines to Turn Away Excess Supply
items.summary: Natural gas pipelines in Appalachia and the Northeast are tightening restrictions on shippers as mild weather and storage injection constraints leave New England cash prices trading at about half the Henry Hub benchmark.

items.title: Canadian Natural Targets Global Prices as AECO Natural Gas Discounts Persist
items.summary: Canadian Natural Resources is hedging against weak local benchmark prices by exposing only one-third of its natural gas production to AECO and Station 2 pricing.

items.title: Iran War Fuels Louisiana LNG Interest, Complicates Woodside Dealmaking

items.title: Natural Gas Fighting to Carry $3 Handle Into Weekend

items.title: Sempra Sees Manufacturing, Oil and Natural Gas Supporting Texas Utility Growth
items.summary: Sempra pointed to growing power demand from manufacturers and oil and gas producers Thursday to support its Texas growth outlook as election results clouded prospects for new data centers and the company neared a deal sharpening its utility focus.

items.title: Why $1 Spot Prices Aren’t Enough to Rescue Appalachian Natural Gas Markets
items.summary: The pipeline squeeze that drove Permian Basin natural gas prices below zero for stretches of the past three years has found a new home in Appalachia, where compounding hurdles stand between the basin and a price recovery.

items.title: U.S. Oil, Gas Drillers See Minor Uptick as Oil Prices Crash
items.summary: The total number of active drilling rigs for oil and gas in the United States rose slightly this week, according to new data that Baker Hughes published on Friday, with the total rig count in the US rising to 604, up 56 from this same time last year.
